text:
You need someone to take your store and event CRM data spread across roughly 40 Excel sheets, consolidate it into one master sheet, visualize the summary, and then turn the existing data into a buyer persona report.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization using SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. For this kind of work, I focus on making messy multi-sheet data reliable first, then building a clear structure for reporting and insight generation.

A relevant project I completed was a Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture in retail. I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model that replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports. That consolidation reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. That project required exactly the kind of careful data modeling, cleaning, and summary reporting your job needs.

For your project, I would approach it in three stages:
1. Review the current sheets, identify common fields, and clean/standardize the data.
2. Consolidate the numbers into a master sheet and create a dashboard or visual summary for the key metrics.
3. Analyze the combined data for patterns and build a buyer persona report based on the findings.

I’m comfortable working with Excel formulas, structured data cleanup, and dashboard presentation, and I can keep the output organized so it’s easy for you to review and reuse. I also understand that the buyer persona part needs to be grounded in the data, not just assumptions, so I would focus on the strongest signals present in the CRM and event data.

If you’d like, I can help turn the scattered sheets into a clean master dataset and a report that clearly explains who your buyers are and what the numbers are showing.
